capabilities: Define CSS snippets with a name, HTML tag, class, and style
Apply snippets to selected text from the context menu
Apply or remove snippets via command palette commands
Reorder, enable, or delete snippets in settings
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS snippet manager for the vault's appearance; it wraps selected text with user-defined HTML tags and inline styles.
extras: Requires basic CSS knowledge; the README links to external guides for HTML tags and style formatting rather than explaining them itself.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of Style Text by Juanjo Arranz.
motivation: The author forked Style Text so that each snippet can specify the HTML tag, class, and style, not just styling.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to apply reusable custom inline HTML/CSS styling to selected text while editing.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of Style Text by Juanjo Arranz.

summary: Fork-based text styler that wraps selected text in user-defined HTML tags, classes, and inline styles via context menu, commands, or hotkeys.
